rules: Paid daily targets are hard minimums and must not be silently reduced for expected-profit optimization.
For 2026-08-23, paid NOTE and BOOTH are strict verified 5/5; only the designated free NOTE 2/2 remains as experimental acquisition work.
The 2026-08-23 BOOTH carry was resolved by independent buyer-visible verification and canonical ledger reconciliation on 2026-08-24.
A paid scheduled slot that cannot reach verified publication is not discarded; it becomes paid publication debt.
Paid publication debt survives date changes and PC power-off periods until buyer/reader-visible publication is verified.
One run may complete multiple publications when debt exists or a paid floor remains; pacing preferences are not production caps.

Do not count queue insertion, local publisher success logs without strict verification, editor/admin URLs, drafts, commits, old-item reverification, or unverified pages as completed paid publications.
Free note articles and unrelated production are secondary to the 2026-08-24 paid NOTE and BOOTH floors.
Cloud-side planning, queue production and publisher repair continue when Windows is unavailable.
Do not disable BOOTH/note automation because of a recoverable publication or verification delay.
If one required BOOTH candidate remains blocked, defer it briefly and switch to another required 2026-08-23 candidate rather than ending the run or falling back to a legacy blocker.
